AWS Certified AI Practitioner · AIF-C01

Exam Overview & Study Strategy

Everything here is pulled directly from the current official AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) Exam Guide, version 1.1 (published April 30, 2026) — domains, task statements, weightings, and in-scope services — plus current administration details from AWS's certification program. This version added agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Kiro, Strands Agents, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore as exam topics.

Exam Administration

Format and logistics

Question formatMultiple choice, multiple response, ordering, and matching
Number of questions65 total — 50 that count toward your score, plus 15 unscored questions AWS uses to evaluate for future exams. You won't know which is which, and there's no penalty for guessing.
Duration90 minutes
Passing score700 out of a scaled range of 100–1,000 (not a raw percentage — AWS uses a compensatory model, so weak performance in one domain can be offset by strength in another)
Cost$100 USD
Delivery methodPearson VUE testing center, or online proctored from home
LanguagesEnglish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese (Brazil)
PrerequisitesNone formally required
Validity3 years from the pass date
Target candidateUp to ~6 months of exposure to AI/ML on AWS; uses AI/ML solutions but doesn't necessarily build them

Study Strategy & Roadmap

A condensed 2-week plan: survey, then deep-dive weighted by domain

Days 1–2 are a fast survey, not a deep dive: skim every domain's Cheat Sheet and answer the built-in Practice Check questions in the Domain Review tab. The goal is to see real exam-style questions and terminology across all 5 domains immediately, so you know where you're weakest before committing real study time. The rest of the plan allocates study days in rough proportion to each domain's exam weighting — Domain 3 (28%) gets the most days, and Domains 4 and 5 combined (14% + 14% = 28%) get an equal amount of time right alongside it. At the end of every week, drill exactly what you just covered: go to the Practice Question Bank, filter to only that domain, turn on "Load all available questions," and work through every question for it in Practice Mode before moving on.

Pacing, question-reading technique, and decoding AWS's qualifier words

Time Management — Pacing Checkpoints

If you're behind pace at any checkpoint, flag the question and move on rather than getting stuck — you can return to flagged questions during the review buffer.

Bottom-Up Question Reading

    Practice Question Bank

    Drill by domain, choose your mode, and go. Practice Mode gives you feedback after every question; Exam Simulation Mode times you and withholds feedback until the end, just like the real thing.

    1. Choose a mode

    📘 Practice Mode

    Instant feedback after each question, with the correct answer and full explanation. No timer. Best for learning.

    ⏱️ Exam Simulation Mode

    Timed to a fixed 90 minutes, no feedback until you finish — mirrors real exam conditions.

    2. Number of questions

    Exam Simulation Mode always draws 65 questions from all domains, weighted to match the real exam's breakdown (or fewer only if the full question bank has less than 65 available), timed to a fixed 90 minutes — matching the real exam. The settings below don't apply in this mode.

    Schedule Your Exam

    Once you're consistently passing the practice bank, it's time to book the real thing. If you're in Indonesia, AWS runs a "Get AWS Certified: Foundational" challenge that can get you a 100% discount voucher for the exam (while supplies last). Follow the steps below in order to claim it and register.

    Step 1 — Register for the learning plan first

    1. Open the AWS "AWS Ada Untuk Indonesia" skill-building page:
      Open AWS page ↗
    2. On the "Rencana Pembelajaran Machine Learning dan Generative AI" card, click "Belajar Sekarang" and complete the registration. Do this before claiming the voucher in Step 2.

      The card to look for:

    Step 2 — Get your free certification voucher

    1. Back on the same page, find the "Raih Peluang Karir Baru / Dapatkan Sertifikasi AWS" card and click "Dapatkan voucher sertifikasi Anda".

      The card to look for:

    2. Fill out the registration form. Important: make sure you select Indonesia as your country — the voucher offer is tied to that selection, so the wrong country will disqualify you.
    3. Submit the form. You'll receive a confirmation email containing your voucher code (check spam/promotions if it doesn't arrive shortly).

    Note: the 100% discount is offered "selama persediaan masih ada" (while supplies last) and is subject to AWS's terms and conditions. Availability isn't guaranteed — claim it early.

    Step 3 — Register for the AI Practitioner exam

    1. Go to the AWS Certification portal and sign in (or create an AWS Certification account):
      AWS Certification portal ↗
    2. Choose to schedule the AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) exam.
    3. Pick your delivery method: Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored from home.
    4. At checkout, enter the voucher code from your confirmation email to apply the discount before completing the booking.

    Exam facts to keep in mind when booking: 65 questions, 90 minutes, passing score 700/1000, available in English / Japanese / Korean / Simplified Chinese / Brazilian Portuguese.
